title: pharn-ci Report v2
description: Machine-readable output of pharn-ci since 0.2.0. This schema is the source of truth: markdown and CLI text are renderings of this object. v2 is Report v1 (schema/report.v1.json) plus optional top-level objects: every v1 field keeps its name, type and meaning, and schemaVersion is the number 2. A missing optional object means that part did not run. Within schemaVersion 2 fields are never removed or retyped; new optional fields may only be added by updating this file. Format keywords are annotations.

message.description: A v1 message (schema/report.v1.json#/$defs/message) with the same fields and constraints. v2 documents its own codes here so codes added in v2 are listed in v2.

code.description: Stable identifier; branch on this, never on text. Known codes: DIFF_COVERAGE_BELOW_THRESHOLD, DIFF_COVERAGE_UNGATED, NO_COVERABLE_CHANGES, COVERAGE_FILE_MISSING, COVERAGE_FILE_EMPTY, COVERAGE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED, DIFF_UNAVAILABLE, NO_AGENT_SETUP_FILES. Every v1 code keeps its meaning and level in v2 (schema/report.v1.json documents COVERAGE_PATHS_UNMATCHED, COVERAGE_PATHS_PARTIALLY_UNMATCHED, CONFIG_CHANGED_IN_DIFF, COVERAGE_FILE_TRACKED, DIFF_BINARY_COVERED_FILE, AGENT_SETUP_FILE_EMPTY, TEST_FILES_DELETED, AGENT_SETUP_EXPECTED_MISSING and COVERAGE_LINES_SKIPPED). Codes added in v2: TEST_INTEGRITY_MODE_IGNORED (warn: .pharn/ci.yml set test_integrity.mode looser than the workflow input or the default, so it was ignored), TEST_INTEGRITY_OFF (info: the effective test-integrity mode is off), TEST_INTEGRITY_TI01 (TI01, test file deleted: error when a deleted or renamed-away test file defined tests and the mode is block, warn in mode warn, info when the change also deletes the source of the same name or its package, or adds a test file of the same name; every file is in testIntegrity.signals), TEST_INTEGRITY_TI11 (TI11, CI stopped running tests: error when a workflow loses a test step or its pull request trigger and the mode is block, warn otherwise, including for a reduced matrix, an added continue-on-error, a disabling if: or a near-zero timeout; every finding is in testIntegrity.signals) and TEST_INTEGRITY_TI14 (TI14, diff-coverage exclusions widened: error when the check config lowers the coverage threshold or adds an exclusion and the mode is block, warn in mode warn; every finding is in testIntegrity.signals), TEST_INTEGRITY_TI03 (TI03, a skip added to a test file: error when an unconditional skip is added to a test the diff shows existed and the mode is block, warn in mode warn; warn for a conditional skip, a skip inside a test body and a skip in a test the change adds; every finding is in testIntegrity.signals) and TEST_INTEGRITY_TI04 (TI04, a focused-run marker added to a JS/TS test file: error when .only, fit or fdescribe is added and the mode is block, warn in mode warn; every finding is in testIntegrity.signals), TEST_INTEGRITY_TI10 (TI10, a test script in package.json weakened: error when an added test script ignores the exit status of a command, prints or exits 0 in place of running the tests, passes with no tests, or limits the run to a path or name pattern, or when a pretest or posttest script is removed, and the mode is block, warn in mode warn; every finding is in testIntegrity.signals) and TEST_INTEGRITY_TI13 (TI13, a coverage-ignore comment added to source: error when an Istanbul, V8 or C8 ignore hint or a coverage.py no-cover pragma is added to a JavaScript, TypeScript or Python file that is not a test file and the mode is block, warn in mode warn; every finding is in testIntegrity.signals), TEST_INTEGRITY_TEXT_TRUNCATED (warn: the diff text of a file a test-integrity signal reads was cut at 5000 changed lines, so a finding past the cut is not seen; the message names those files and is not given in mode off), TEST_INTEGRITY_ACCEPTED (info, Action only: a reviewer who is not the PR author applied the accept label, so every block signal was downgraded to warn; testIntegrity.accepted names the label and the reviewer) and TEST_INTEGRITY_ACCEPT_IGNORED (warn, Action only: the accept label was looked at and does not count, because the PR author applied it, a non-user account applied it, no labeling event was found, or the pull request or its events could not be read; the block signals stand), TEST_INTEGRITY_TI02 (TI02, a test removed: error when a test of a file that stays has no test of the same name or a similar body left in the touched test files and the mode is block, warn in mode warn and for a test whose name is computed; the signal sits at the base path and base line; the text names every file of the id and says how many findings the 20-per-file cap left out; every listed finding is in testIntegrity.signals), TEST_INTEGRITY_TI05 (TI05, assertions emptied or dropped: error when a test that had assertions at base has none at head and calls no assertion helper and the mode is block, warn in mode warn, when a helper call may hold the assertions and when only some assertions are gone with the rest of the body unchanged; the text names every file of the id and the cap's count; every listed finding is in testIntegrity.signals) and TEST_INTEGRITY_INDEX_UNAVAILABLE (warn: touched JS/TS or Python test files could not be compared at the merge base and at HEAD, so TI02 and TI05 did not check them, or TI02 and TI05 did not run because the test text could not be read; the message names the files with a reason code each, or the reason; it is not given in mode off). New codes may be added within v2; consumers must tolerate unknown codes. No code is removed or renamed before 1.0.

testIntegrity.description: Test-integrity findings for the change under review. mode: the effective mode (block | warn | off); source: where it came from; verdict: from the signals and the mode; languages: which detectors ran; accepted: set by the Action when a reviewer who is not the PR author applied the accept label to a pull request run in mode block; acceptLabel: the Action's accept-label input when it is not the default.

acceptLabel.description: The name of the accept label the Action was given in its accept-label input. Written by the Action only, and only when it is not the default pharn/accepted (compared case-insensitively); absent from a CLI report and from a default run. At most 50 characters.

accepted.description: Who signed off the block findings. Written by the Action only: label is the accept label as configured, by is the login of the user account (not the PR author) that applied it. Null or absent when nothing was accepted.

languages.description: Which syntax-aware detectors ran: ts, js, py, go. Empty in 0.2.x, whose signals read diff lines only; from 0.3.0 the test indexes fill ts, js and py with the sorted languages of the test files they parsed at the merge base or at HEAD (the Go detectors are not shipped).

meta.description: Run metadata, present when the Action ran. Absent from a CLI run.
